# Most freestyle football world titles won (male)
![Most freestyle football world titles won \(male\)](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/images/record.jpg)
**Share**

[ Contact an Account Manager ](https://business.guinnessworldrecords.com/contact-us?source=Website-EN-B2B%20Form) Who
    Erlend Fagerli What
     10 total number  Where
     Not Applicable  When
     25 January 2024 
The most football-freestyle world titles won by a male, according to the World Freestyle Football Association (WFFA), is 10, achieved by Erlend Fagerli (Norway) as of 25 January 2024.
Fagerli acquired 10 world titles after winning the World Freestyle Football Championship once (2023), the Red Bull Street Style tournament four times (2018, 2020–22), and the Super Ball five times (2016, 2018–19, 2021–22). He has also won one regional competition, the 2023 Pulse Riga, which took place in Latvia between 28–29 July 2023.
Fagerli, who retired in late 2023, is considered by many in the sport to be the greatest of all time. 
The most freestyle-football world titles won by a female, according to the World Freestyle Football Association (WFFA), is six, and was achieved by Mélody Donchet (France) between 2013 and 2022; and equalled by Aguśka Mnich (Poland) between 2018 and 2023.
Records change on a daily basis and are not immediately published online. For a full list of record titles, please use our Record Application Search. (You will need to register / login for access)
